incident: Install device picker reports no PS5 connection or unavailable installed-package check although root and PKG installer respond
findings: The device picker retains its own preview snapshot; explicit refresh reused the ordinary 15-second profile cache
The installed-package check required ShadowMount-backed console/info after reading the system catalog, even for base PS5 PKG
This info dependency existed since c4d5c85 on 2026-10-11; later 91c3c5b formatting did not introduce it
consoleGames qualification and ShadowMount API availability are separate; loss of a qualification marker was not established
scope: Explicit picker refresh bypasses profile TTL while preserving background transfer handling and in-flight coalescing
Explicit base PS5 PKG presence is conservatively derived from a complete stable system catalog without console/info; metadata is not treated as exact-version proof
Explicit overwrite review and catalog revision binding remain required; other content checks are retained
Passive activity scans share pending promises until completion, start TTL after settlement and use one-at-a-time PS5 checks per scan; PS4 keeps concurrency eight

checks.fixtureCorrection: Empty catalog refresh fixture includes total=0 to match the real root contract
checks.peerReview: Picker and catalog diffs have no remaining P1/P2; overstrict metadata validation was corrected
checks.hardware: Baseline diagnosis only; no new installation or deployment

hardwareValidationLimit: Live baseline diagnosed on Windows 1.10.24; fixes are not yet deployed or validated by a real reinstallation

formatRouting.pkg: PackageFlow transfer and PackageFlowInstaller-PS5 system installation
formatRouting.ffpkg: UFS2 image mounted and registered via ShadowMount
formatRouting.folder: PackageFlow tree transfer and verification, then ShadowMount source registration

limits: Own-service catalog latency exceeded the one-shot capture timeout; the exact runtime congestion source remains a hypothesis
This change is scoped to base PS5 PKG; patch/DLC and other format proof paths retain their existing checks
passivePollingLimit: A single mounted client already uses activityRefreshRunning; cross-client/remount pending duplication and burst concurrency were reproduced in mocked host tests. The captured hardware timeout is not attributed conclusively to this mechanism.
